name: pygments-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Pygments, a generic syntax highlighter written in Python: lexers
split source text into a stream of typed tokens, filters transform that stream, and formatters render
it as HTML, LaTeX, RTF, SVG, images, terminal escape sequences and other formats using a style. It
ships a public Python API (`lex`, `format`, `highlight` and the lexer, formatter, filter and style
lookup functions), base classes for writing new lexers, formatters, filters and styles, and the
`pygmentize` command line.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the Pygments highlighting core and its user documentation: the top-level modules of the pygments package (pygments/__init__.py, cmdline.py, console.py, filter.py, formatter.py, lexer.py, modeline.py, plugin.py, regexopt.py, scanner.py, style.py, token.py and util.py), the pygments/filters and pygments/formatters packages, the style lookup in pygments/styles/__init__.py, the lexer lookup in pygments/lexers/__init__.py, and the lexer modules pygments/lexers/special.py, python.py, shell.py, diff.py and data.py; together with README.rst, doc/faq.rst and the documentation pages under doc/docs/ (index, api, quickstart, cmdline, lexers, filters, formatters, styles, tokens, unicode, lexerdevelopment, formatterdevelopment, filterdevelopment, styledevelopment, plugins, integrate, terminal-sessions, terminaltips and security), and the module, class and function docstrings of those m
